correctness.rationale: For prime powers, H(p^a)=sum_{j=0}^{a-1}p^{2j}-p^{a-1}, yielding 0 for prime, p²-p+1 for square and 1+p⁴ for cubes, with exponents >=4 bounded >=57. The exact expansion H(p^a q^b)=q^{2b}h_{p,a}+p^{2a}h_{q,b}+S_{p,a}S_{q,b}+R_{p,a}R_{q,b} yields H(pq)=2 and sharp >=34 when the smaller-prime block is repeated; other repeated block placement >=41. Adjoining a coprime prime-power increases H(mp^a)>p^{2a}H(m), so >=three distinct primes forces >50. Equality reduces uniquely to 2²*3=12. Independent sieve n=2..40000 reproduced the four low non-semiprime examples and sole H=34 at12. Infinite claim is symbolic, sieve corroborative.
